_comment: Three rounds landing on ONE seam, but each a different invariant family and severity falling P1 → P2 → P3. No class reaches three rounds, and per docs/review-policy.md falling severity is convergence, so the gate must let this through.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the session after the await**

The row is read before the await and `writeSessionMessage` runs after it, so a concurrent archive wins the race.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat an absent outbound file as empty**

When the file is missing this returns undefined and the caller reads a null field; return an empty list instead.

**<sub><sub>![P3 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P3-blue?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Roll back the stamp when the write throws**

The row is persisted before the write and never rolled back on failure, so a partial rollback leaves the stamp behind.
